title: Genome-wide analysis of data generated on the Affymetrix 10K Xba 142 arrays for identification of regions with high probability to contain genes responsible for Micronodular \(non-pigmented) Adrenocortical Hyperplasia
protocol: Utilize the Genetic Algorithm Module to find logical combinations of SNP's for association studies.
Calculate Chi Square, Yates, Fisher Exact, Odds Ratio, LD, D', etc., using the Association Study Module.
Perform LOH analysis on the dataset using user-specified controls as a reference set with the Chromosome Alteration module.
Utilize the AS module to provide extensive statistical analysis of the dataset including Fishers Exact by genotype and allele.
Calculate Odds Ratio by genotype and allele using the AS module.
Use the AS module for feature selection of the dataset prior to inputting it into the GA Module.
Run the Genetic Algorithm Module against the dataset multiple times with different parameter settings.
Run GA module against the entire input dataset.
Build models of smallest size that can effectively predict outcomes while minimizing False Positives and maximizing True Positives.
Employ various feature selection methods to reduce the input parameter space.
Calculate a p-value for each SNP using Fisher's method.
Eliminate SNPs if their p-value does not fall below a certain threshold.
Calculate minor allele frequency for each SNP for cases and controls.
Eliminate SNPs from consideration if variance is below a defined threshold.
Run Exemplars CA Module against the dataset to detect possible deletions in chromosomes by looking for Loss Of Heterozygosity.
Assign a p-value to each SNP.
